baseline_gap_evidence.gap_text: Crisis/chaos specs exercise shock surfaces; a focused end-to-end assertion binding a shock event to the adaptive re-evaluation of BusinessConditionProfile + InterventionMode/InterventionPhase + priority + review cadence is owed.
baseline_gap_evidence.prior_coverage: shock-01-persist.db.test.ts mocks @/services/re-evaluation and @/services/shock-detection; the real shock -> re-eval binding was never exercised

product_defect.description: engagement select used relation `conditionProfiles`, but the Engagement relation is `businessConditionProfiles`; prisma.engagement.findFirst threw PrismaClientValidationError on every call, so shock detection and createShockEvent failed unconditionally. Latent: shock-01-persist.db.test.ts mocks shock-detection.
product_defect.owner_visible_via: createShockEvent (shock event write path) threw on every call
product_defect.fix: rename conditionProfiles -> businessConditionProfiles in the select and its usage engagement.businessConditionProfiles[0]. No schema/contract change; ShockDetectionResult shape unchanged.

proof_tests.lane: required maintained vitest suite (CI - Build & Test, TEST_WITH_DB=true)

cases.name: binding
cases.asserts: createShockEvent persists the ShockEvent + detectionConfirmed=true + SHOCK_EVENT_RECORDED audit; and BINDS into governed re-eval: CONDITION_CHANGED audit emitted AND engagement.interventionPhase re-evaluated+persisted (growth -> re-evaluated) with version bump

cases.name: dimensions
cases.asserts: triggerReEvaluation(shock_event) => targets ALL true (incl interventionPhase); recommendedRating=critical; recommendedMode=recovery; interventionPhaseImpact.canAdvance boolean; priorityImpact both escalate; reviewCadenceImpact(3 days, critical); healthStatusImpact present; auditEventId truthy

kpi_vs_shock_contrast: G3 (kpi_deterioration) excludes interventionPhase; G4 (shock_event) includes it. Both asserted, proving the governed target map is change-type-specific.

verified determineReEvaluationTargets(shock_event) all-true + evaluateInterventionPhaseImpact no-findings->triage + evaluator thresholds against source
